symptom: `mxcli check -p` (0.28.0) warned MDL-WIDGET10 that `dynamictext x (Content: '…')` — top-level or in a Data grid 2 column — had its `content` hidden and ignored; the page rendered it and mx check accepted it; no warning without a project (ako/mxcli#1865, mendixlabs/mxcli#1707)
cause: the project's `.mxcli/widgets/` held a pluggable definition registered under the builder-owned keyword `dynamictext`, so check validated the Forms$DynamicText against that widget's editorConfig visibility rules; already closed on main by mendixlabs/mxcli#1463 (registry refuses builder-owned names, lookupWidgetDef never resolves one)
insight: **A project-only false MDL-WIDGET10 on a NON-pluggable keyword means a definition is answering for a keyword the builder owns** — not a visibility-rule bug. Check what `.mxcli/widgets/*.def.json` registers under that mdlName before touching the rule evaluation. Reproduced by writing the shadowing def into a temp project; control (dropping `dynamictext` from the builder-owned set) brings back the warning at both locations.
